title: Confirmation Decision
description: Payload of a confirm:approve or confirm:reject envelope — the producer's answer to a confirm:request for a destructive operation (Requirements 22.2, 22.3). One schema serves both envelope types because the shape is identical and the envelope type already carries the verdict; the decision property states it a second time so the payload is self-describing when it is logged, persisted, or read apart from its envelope. A client that disagreed with itself — confirm:approve carrying decision rejected — is rejected here rather than resolved by precedence, since neither reading is safe to guess at for an operation the producer was asked about. Only the two answers a producer can give are representable: an expiry is the server's own conclusion, broadcast as confirm:resolved, and never sent by a client.

requestId.description: The requestId the confirm:request envelope carried, echoed back so the AgentCore Client settles the confirmation this answers. The envelope carries it too and that is the copy the server correlates on; it is repeated here so the payload identifies its own subject.

decision.description: The producer's verdict. Must agree with the envelope type — approved for confirm:approve, rejected for confirm:reject.
